_comment: Laundry on a line is the single best motion cue in the menu -- it moves constantly, it moves softly, and it moves in a way no viewer reads as camera work. That is why this place exists even though it is the least dramatic scene here.
label: Balcony, washing on the line

prompt._comment: The courtyard below matters: it is what says apartment block rather than terraced house, and it gives the shot depth in a space two metres deep.
prompt.scene: a narrow concrete balcony on the third floor of a 1970s apartment block, bedsheets and towels pegged along a line strung corner to corner, a red plastic peg bag, a geranium in a window box, the courtyard and more balconies below
prompt.light: flat midday brightness through thin high cloud, the concrete pale, no strong shadow anywhere
prompt.lens: wide and close in a tight space, the far balconies falling slightly out of focus
prompt.framing: chest-up, turned back towards the flat, one hand still up at the line
prompt.eraProps: wooden pegs, a red plastic washing-up bowl, a satellite dish two balconies along, a small grey mobile phone with a monochrome screen on the ledge

motionHint: the bedsheets lift and fall on the line and the brightness shifts as thin cloud passes

lookOverride._comment: Flat overcast has no highlight to bloom and no colour to push, so this pulls saturation down and leans the midtones very slightly cold. Grain drops a touch: bright flat scenes show it far more than a dark interior does.
